posts.title: Triplox Log 1 - Introduction
posts.description: I am working on a Datalog database engine à la Datomic on top of object storage. The system is called Triplox (a portemanteau of Triple and Blocks). In an attempt to become a better communicator I decided to start a little log to explain some concepts in Triplox.
